verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships both a documented REST API with explicit trigger/acknowledge/resolve and escalation endpoints (docs-21, docs-32, docs-39) and an official MCP server (local and hosted) confirmed live via runtime probe with OAuth/token auth (docs-1, docs-14, docs-34, probe-2, probe-rt-1), enabling an agent to manage the full incident lifecycle without a dashboard. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that an agent using MCP can complete a full ack→escalate→resolve workflow end-to-end (only API-level and connectivity evidence, no full agentic workflow case study).
